bookMeeting.label: Book a meeting
bookMeeting.help: If they are interested, the agent agrees to send a booking link on WhatsApp; follow-ups chase until they book.

humanCallback.label: Hand over to the team
humanCallback.help: If they are interested, the agent confirms it and agrees when a person from your team will call; the lead lands in Action required.

either.label: Either, their choice
either.help: The agent offers the booking link, or a call from the team if they prefer.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

numberPicker.empty: No calling numbers yet. <link>Add one in Settings → WhatsApp → Calling numbers</link>, link it to WhatsApp Web, then come back. You can still save this campaign as a draft.
numberPicker.readyOnTitle: WhatsApp Web is kept open on {host}, so calls start right away

section.title: AI agent campaigns
section.description: The agent calls the leads itself from your calling numbers, follows up on WhatsApp, and hands over interested people.
section.emptyDescription: Set a goal, pick calling numbers and add leads. The agent follows your sequence of calls and WhatsApp messages.

detail.archiveDescription: Calls and messages stop and the campaign leaves the list. Calls already placed stay on each lead, with their recordings and transcripts.
detail.created: Created {date} · {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} in the sequence
detail.createdWithDescription: Created {date} · {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} in the sequence · {description}
detail.draftNote: This campaign is a draft and places nothing until you launch it.

stats.callsTodayHint: Calls placed today, against what the campaign's numbers may place a day
stats.bookedHint: Meetings booked by leads of this campaign

wizard.pageDescription: The AI agent calls your leads by itself from your calling numbers, follows up on WhatsApp, and hands over interested people. It stays a draft until you launch it.

goal.title: Name and goal
goal.description: Name the campaign and say what its calls are for.

numbers.title: Calling numbers
numbers.description: Pick the numbers this campaign calls from. Each lead is called and messaged from one of them and keeps hearing from the same one.
numbers.hint: A new number warms up gradually, and every number has its own daily limit and calling hours (Settings → WhatsApp → Calling numbers and Sending rules). You can launch with a number still being linked, but nothing is called until it is.

leads.title: Add leads
leads.description: Import a spreadsheet with phone numbers, or select people already in your database.
leads.importHint: You map the phone column before anything is imported.
leads.peopleHint: Select existing people who already have a phone number.
leads.added: {count, plural, one {# lead added} other {# leads added}}
leads.noneNote: You can continue with no leads and add them later; the campaign cannot launch until it has some.

script.title: Script and sequence
script.description: What every call is about, who the agent is, and the calls and messages to send. The defaults are a sensible start.
script.instructionsHint: What every call is about, on top of the Knowledge above: who you are calling, what you offer, what to find out.
script.instructionsPlaceholder: You are calling founders of D2C brands who run Meta ads. We help them …
script.bookingMessageHint: The WhatsApp sent right after they agree to book. Must include {token}.
script.chaseTitle: If they said yes but haven't booked
script.chaseDescription: Runs after the booking message, until they book, reply, or the steps run out and a person takes over.

review.title: Review and launch
review.description: Nothing is called until you launch. You can save it as a draft and finish later.
review.chase: Then {count, plural, one {# follow-up step} other {# follow-up steps}} for leads who say yes but do not book.
review.hours: Calls start within the numbers' calling hours, spaced out and capped per day. A reply on any channel stops the sequence and lands in CRM → Action required.
review.blocker: {blocker} before launching. You can save it as a draft and finish later.

steps.waitLine: Wait {delay}, if they have not had a real conversation
steps.callPlaceholder: On top of the campaign instructions: e.g. “Second try: mention you called yesterday.”
steps.newStepWarning: This step is new: save the sequence first so the rehearsal uses it.
steps.rehearsalVoiceHint: A call with the agent in your browser, with the campaign's last saved instructions, this step, its voice and goal. Nothing is placed or saved.
steps.rehearsalTextHint: Plays the agent against you in text, with the campaign's last saved instructions and this step. Nothing is placed or saved.
steps.previewEmpty: Write the message to see it here.

knowledge.noneSelected: None — the calls only know the instructions
knowledge.metaCharsAlways: {kind} · {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · always include
knowledge.loadFailed: Could not load the Knowledge documents: {error}
knowledge.hint: Company facts the agent can draw on. Manage documents in CRM → Knowledge.
knowledge.hintUsed: Company facts the agent can draw on — {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}, all read on every call. Manage documents in CRM → Knowledge.

sequence.reachDescription: Runs for every lead, in order, until they have a real conversation. Picking up and saying nothing does not count as one.
sequence.reachEmpty: Add at least one call. A campaign without a call step cannot be launched.
sequence.reachFooter: The first step runs as soon as a lead is queued and a number is free. Each wait is counted from the previous step. Calls and messages respect the numbers' calling hours and daily limits.
sequence.chaseTitle: If they said yes but haven't booked
sequence.chaseDescription: After a call where they agree to a meeting, the booking message goes out on WhatsApp. These steps then run until a booking arrives, they reply, or the steps run out and a person takes over.
sequence.chaseEmpty: No follow-ups: once the booking message is sent, a person takes over if they do not book.
